source_lines: for row in range(row_start, height, size):
for col in range(col_start, width, size):
block = grid[row:min(row + size, height), col:min(col + size, width)]
result[row:min(row + size, height), col:min(col + size, width)] = np.where(block == background, fill, block)
rationale: The azure marks occupy aligned 4×4 tiles, anchored at the minimum occupied row and column. Fill background cells within every occupied tile with red, preserving azure marks and leaving empty tiles unchanged.
